docs.summary: Represents a single draw call containing rendering state and the number of elements to draw.
The number of index elements (vertices * 3) in this draw call.
The brush state for this draw call, containing gradient and texture information.
Gets the texture from the brush. Returns null if no texture is set.

The font atlas texture for text in this draw call, or null if it contains no text. Backends bind this to a dedicated sampler unit; the default shader samples it for text fragments (UV >= 2) while shapes sample [`Texture`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Texture).
Gets the custom shader from the brush. Returns null if no custom shader is set (uses default).
Gets the shader uniforms from the brush. Returns null if no custom uniforms are set.

members.signature: public void GetScissor(float framebufferScale, out Float4 transform, out Float2 translation, out Float2 extent)

docs.summary: The scissor transform as a 2D affine with the framebuffer scale folded in, plus the extent the shader compares against. The extent already carries the half-pixel feather, so the shader is a subtract and two clamps.
docs.remarks: A negative extent means no scissor, which the shader early-outs on.
